controls.name: frozen_predicates
controls.requirement: Use the declared P127/P128 candidate predicates without semantic edits.

controls.name: held_out_split
controls.requirement: Use only the declared C4-C6 generated cases and do not import prior result rows.

controls.name: blind_expected_labels
controls.requirement: Keep expected labels separate until both replay passes complete.

controls.name: complete_field_binding
controls.requirement: Check context, ordered source payload, witness, trace, history, and threshold fields independently.

controls.name: exact_replay
controls.requirement: Run both deterministic replay passes and compare canonical output hashes.

controls.name: counterexample_preservation
controls.requirement: Preserve every mismatch, unexpected admission, rejection, or leakage flag.
